defectFoundByThisRun.finding: The marker assertions compared against raw SSE frames joined by newlines. A provider streams one event per chunk, so Claude's reply arrived as "C" + "LAUDE_LI" + "VE_START_OK" and the assertion failed on the framing while the run itself had succeeded. Codex passed earlier only because its chunk boundaries happened not to split the marker, so this was a latent flake for either provider.
